messages:
Avery (Product): morning 44b we need to finalize the tiering + add-on rules before the pricing workshop at 10. main open: how to present reserved concurrency (slots), onboarding credit format (USD vs token), and a clear launch grace for pilots.
Liam (Finance): keep primitives minimal: tiers + slots. propose slot = $325/mo base + $0.15/slot-hour. annual commit = 18% off. onboarding credit = USD one-time, expires after first invoice.
Noor (Sales): customer feedback: they want a named "Launch Grace" for first production rollout (30d) and an easy visual on invoices. AE prefers a worked example per tier (dollars not tokens).
Priyanka (Legal): redline language for Launch Grace: "During the 30-day Launch Grace following provisioning, Provider will bill at list; Customer may request discretionary credits within 60 days; Provider is not obligated to issue refunds." also require 30-day notice for downsizing reserved slots on annual terms.
Ethan (Eng): ops constraints: reserved slots must be pre-provisioned; we need a minimum amortization window of 30 days to avoid churn. Priority-routing add-on means dedicated routing lanes -> region-gated: US first, EU TBA.
Avery (Product): suggested public product shape: Starter (metered, trial softcap 8M tokens), Scale (1 slot + 75M burst, quarterly/annual), Pro (5 slots, SLA, 24/7). Priority-routing sold per-slot to all tiers.
Liam (Finance): gating metrics for GA: 2 pilots on Scale/Pro covering >= $70k ARR, billing E2E tests pass, and reserved-slot amortization impact < 3% margin.
Noor (Sales): I'll push for two pilot commitments with BetaCo and Cloudly tonight. asking for Growth quarterly to avoid annual legal delays.
Priyanka (Legal): will add Launch Grace and downsize notice to Term Sheet and provide SLA credit table draft by 17:00.
Ethan (Eng): I'll add feature flags for region gating and a perf test for priority-routing to the release checklist. ETA EOD.
OpsBot: billing-config v3 deployed to staging at 2026-03-21T18:05:12Z (CI#5123) :white_check_mark:
Avery (Product): deck decision: publish three tiers, price slots as Liam suggested, onboarding credit in USD applied to first invoice, 30-day Launch Grace billed at list with discretionary review. include a worked invoice example. objections?
Liam (Finance): none. include an amortization example for slots in appendix.
Noor (Sales): 44d will create a customer one-pager with the worked examples after the deck.
Avery (Product): ok will update and ping for final review at 09:30. thanks all.
